promotionalText: Explore interactive 3D price levels, Pattern X-Ray and Liquidity Guard. Upload a chart for bullish, bearish and wait scenarios. Your first analysis is free.
description:
See your chart from both sides before you decide.

Pocket Bullseye turns chart screenshots into a structured second opinion, with interactive scanners, cinematic results and a written analysis you can revisit.

EXPLORE THE CHART
• Interactive 3D levels scanner: explore visible support, resistance and reference levels.
• Pattern X-Ray and Pattern Watch: inspect pattern context and the evidence behind it.
• Liquidity Guard: examine possible liquidity zones and sweep risks.
• Bullish, bearish and wait scenarios: compare conditions that could support or weaken a setup.

KEEP THE CONTEXT
Start with one clear chart screenshot. Add up to four supporting images of the same instrument, then switch between the available chart timeframes. Review market structure, chart quality, risk flags and calendar context where available.

REVIEW AT YOUR PACE
Watch the cinematic analysis or read the written version. Explore individual levels, revisit scenarios and use reanalysis or correction tools when the chart needs clarification.

TRY ONE ANALYSIS FREE
Your first complete chart analysis is free. Continued analysis requires an auto-renewable monthly subscription. Apple displays the price for your storefront before purchase. Restore Purchases is available in the app, including after subscribing.

Pocket Bullseye reads the evidence visible in uploaded screenshots. It is not a live price feed and does not execute trades or connect to a brokerage account. Its educational, conditional analysis is not personalised financial advice and does not guarantee outcomes. Verify levels and market information independently before acting.

Manage or cancel your subscription in Apple Account settings. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
